single_hypothesis: FP32 D=32768 wide rows seed the full-y process tile at 6112 instead of 4096 so the UB budget buys fewer tile rounds (8 to 6); every other dtype/D cell keeps the existing policy.
why_not_duplicate: See 研究/SHAPE-TILING-CHAMPION-X/DEDUP-MATRIX.md and V001. V001 covered the D<=16384 tier (NEEDS_ONE_MORE_LOCAL, not stacked). This is the D=32768-only tier. WIDE-X-FRESH4 widened a global constant on a weak parent; R31B V016 touched only FP16/BF16 seeds; R31A uses a separate 7680 CachedRows path; FULL-R029/MODE-X is a five-mode taxonomy. None covered the FP32 D=32768 tile tier.
change_summary: Add a D=32768 FP32 wide full-y seed tile (6112). No Process* function, reduction, store, dtype or scheduling change. Not stacked with V001.
